3. Any supporting documentation or receipts that detail the itemized charges for both the flight and the insurance.

If there are any adjustments needed, kindly let me know the steps required to rectify them. I would appreciate receiving copies of the corrected invoices or receipts at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for your prompt assistance. Please feel free to contact me via email or phone if you require additional information.

Best regards,

[Your Phone Number]
